thisPc.title: This PC
thisPc.browser: These settings are available in the desktop app.
thisPc.mainRole: This is the main PC: it keeps the business data for this branch.
thisPc.officeRole: This is an office PC connected to the main PC at {{address}}.
thisPc.lanOn: On: office PCs can connect to this PC.
thisPc.lanOff: Off: only this PC can use the data.
thisPc.adminHint: Windows will ask for administrator approval.
thisPc.pairNeedsLan: Turn on office network access first.
thisPc.pairInstructions: On the office PC, choose “Office PC” and enter:
thisPc.backupsHint: A backup is made every day at 3 p.m. Dubai time (or as soon as this PC starts, if it was off) and before every update; the newest {{keep}} are kept.
thisPc.backupsUnavailable: This server does not keep local backups.
thisPc.backupsForbidden: You do not have permission to see backups.
thisPc.restoreConfirm: Replace all current data with the backup from {{date}}? Everything entered after it will be lost.
thisPc.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect this PC? You can pair it again with a new code.

errors.uac_cancelled: Windows administrator approval was not given.
errors.lan_off: Turn on office network access first.
errors.backup_in_progress: A backup is already running; try again in a minute.
errors.failed: That did not work. Details are in the server log on this PC.

thisPc.copyTitle: Copy to a USB drive or NAS
thisPc.copyHint: Every new backup is also copied to this folder, so the data survives if this PC breaks or is stolen. Anyone who can open the folder can read the backups.
thisPc.copyNone: No folder chosen: backups are kept on this PC only.
thisPc.copyNasHint: A NAS folder must let this PC write without a user name and password.
thisPc.publicNetwork: Windows treats {{networks}} as a Public network, so office PCs cannot connect. Switch it to Private if this is your shop's own network.
thisPc.fixedIpHint: Office PCs find this PC again by themselves if its address changes. With a router, reserving a fixed address for this PC (DHCP reservation) avoids even the short wait.
